explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/102: for fixed c>0, h_c(n)→∞, where n points with at least cn² lines each containing more than three force a line with h_c(n) points. h as the minimum of max-collinear is the right reading, and ℕ∞ handles c too large for any configuration, as the docstring explains. Faithful; 'Estimate' is not formalized.
